messages:
dmitri: Heads-up — since ~03:15 UTC p95 latencies on shared-gpu-pool-7 jumped ~4x. p50 unchanged. Appears tied to tenant t-43 bursts. traces show long kernel_exec times + repeated KV cache misses.
simon: Can you paste a short stack/log snippet? Also which model and seq len distribution?
layla: Model: llama-13B-q8, median seq 128 but t-43 sends a mix with sporadic 2048 requests. Last runtime change was the adaptive-batching tweak (decreased max wait) rolled 1767080450.
dmitri: Log excerpt from runtime kernel selector:
```
[kernel_selector] chosen_kernel=cuda_fused_attn_v2
[kernel_selector] fallback=cublas_gemm due to workspace_limit
[kernel_exec] exec_ms=42
[kv_cache] miss seq_id=... warm=false
[kernel_selector] chosen_kernel=cublas_gemm
[kernel_exec] exec_ms=310
```
layla: That pattern explains spikes — kernel_selector flips to a slower gemm path when workspace is constrained. Long-tail comes from occasional 2k sequences that blow up workspace and thrash KV cache.
carla: I ran a quick sampling profile (nsys) on the busy node, output shows frequent L2 copies and high GPU memory alloc churn when t-43 batch mix hits. Also saw many small batches from adaptive batching -> head-of-line blocking.
simon: Two hypotheses: 1) KV cache thrash + reallocation on large seqs causing page migration and slower kernels. 2) Batching heuristic created mixed-size batches so kernel selector often chooses conservative path.
infra-bot: autoscaler: note — pool-7 at 78% utilization, free_gpus=2.
dmitri: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) apply per-tenant QPS cap for t-43 (soft cap 20 r/s) 2) reserve ephemeral cache for large-seq tenants (pre-alloc small slab) 3) revert adaptive-batching param to previous value (max_wait 8ms -> 12ms) for pool-7.
layla: I can flip batching param via runtime flags. Suggest we push a canary to pool-7 first.
carla: I'll add a kernel-selector debug flag to log workspace sizes per-request for 1h to validate.
ops-bot: deploy: rolling update started for runtime-config on shared-gpu-pool-7 by layla (canary=10%).
ops-bot: deploy: canary passed, continuing rollout.
ops-bot: deploy: rollout succeeded (1767201250).
dmitri: Enabled per-tenant soft cap on t-43 and pre-allocated cache slab (temporary) at 03:28 UTC.
simon: After changes, initial telemetry: p95 reduced ~55% over next 5m. cpu/gpu busy more stable. KV miss ratio dropped by ~30%.
layla: Still seeing occasional 2-3 outliers — probably client sending single giant requests. Recommend adding explicit seq_len caps at router for shared pools.
carla: Collected kernel-selector logs + nsys traces. Uploading to /mnt/ci/artifacts/1767201123/qos-sampling/ (link: https://artifacts.redwood/pool7/1767201123)
infra-bot: alert: cluster cold-starts for pool-7 < 5 in last hour — ok.
dmitri: Next steps (short):
- ACTION: add seq_len cap 4096 at routing layer for shared pools (layla)
- ACTION: implement per-tenant reservation profile (carla)
- ACTION: schedule deeper perf regression test with large seq mixes (simon)
- ACTION: consider stronger isolation (dedicated / pinned) for t-43 if they keep spike pattern (account team)
carla: I'll keep the kernel-selector debug on for 1h and then rotate logs to S3.
simon: Nice work. Marking this thread resolved for now, reopen if p95 climbs back. :thumbsup:
